crossRefs.note: The Pharisee stood and prayed to himself like this: ‘God, I thank you that I am not like the rest of men…
I fast twice a week. I give tithes of all that I get.’
I tell you that even so there will be more joy in heaven over one sinner who repents, than over ninety-nine righteous…
But he answered his father, ‘Behold, these many years I have served you, and I never disobeyed a commandment of yours…
The young man said to him, “All these things I have observed from my youth. What do I still lack?”
Jesus said to him, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell what you have, and give to the poor, and you will have treasure…
He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”
Jesus looking at him loved him, and said to him, “One thing you lack. Go, sell whatever you have, and give to the poor…
For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.
For being ignorant of God’s righteousness, and seeking to establish their own righteousness, they didn’t subject…
concerning zeal, persecuting the assembly; concerning the righteousness which is in the law, found blameless.

parallels.note: He said to him, “Teacher, I have observed all these things from my youth.”

translations.web: He said, “I have observed all these things from my youth up.”
translations.bsb: “All these I have kept from my youth,” he said.
translations.kjv: And he said, All these have I kept from my youth
translations.asv: And he said, All these things have I observed from my youth up.
